Card Q&A.a: You can give that effect to such Digimon, but if the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the gained effect won't trigger.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to give "[End of Your Turn] Delete 1 of your Digimon" to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects?

Card Q&A.a: No, it doesn't trigger. After this card's [Main] effect gives "[End of Your Turn] Delete 1 of your Digimon" to a Digimon, then it triggers, that Digimon's player will be the player considered to have triggered/activated that effect, therefore  won't trigger.
Card Q&A.q: After this card's [Main] effect gives "[End of Your Turn] Delete 1 of your Digimon" to a Digimon, then that effect deletes a Digimon, does  on that Digimon trigger?

Card Q&A.a: A {Trash} effect can be triggered/activated while its card is in the trash. Such effects can't be triggered or activated in areas other than the trash.
The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.
Card Q&A.q: When one of my Digimon digivolves into [Lilithmon (X Antibody)], in what order can I activate this card's {Trash} [Your Turn] effect and the effects that trigger upon digivolution into that Digimon?

Effect: [Trash] [Your Turn] When any of your Digimon digivolve into [Lilithmon (X Antibody)], by returning this card to the bottom of the deck, activate this card's [Main] effects.
[Main] Until the end of your opponent's turn, give all of their Digimon "[End of Your Turn] Delete 1 of your Digimon."
Security Effect: [Security] Delete 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon.
